message.content:
The modulo \(13\) inverses of \(1,2,\dots,12\) are just the same set \(\{1,2,\dots,12\}\) in some order, since \(13\) is prime.

So the sum of the inverses modulo \(13\) is
\[
1+2+\cdots+12=\frac{12\cdot 13}{2}=78.
\]
Modulo \(13\),
\[
78 \equiv 0 \pmod{13}.
\]

The answer is 0.
